blocks.text: The program is on schedule, and the first round of outreach is now within reach. I am opening this thread so that status, questions, and approvals for the {{fact:f:E-2022-001.client}} media work all sit in one place.

Here is where things stand. The coverage review is finished, and daily monitoring has been running since the start of the engagement. The backgrounder and fact sheet are in second draft, with your team's comments folded in. The reporter list is grouped by beat, with a proposed angle beside each name.
Nothing in the recent coverage of Kirby-Taylor calls for a response at this point. If that changes, I will flag it here first.

To keep to schedule, there are a couple of points where we need your help. Could you confirm which executives will speak for the company, and roughly when each could spare time for a preparation session over the next few weeks? And could you let us know whether pitches need sign-off from anyone besides you? I would like to route each draft correctly from the first one.
